SELECT
p.*,
c.category_name, c.category_description,
s.user_name, s.user_email, s.user_phone, s.user_password, s.shop_name, s.shop_address, s.address_id,
a.house_number, a.street, a.city, a.state, a.country, a.zip_code
FROM products p
INNER JOIN categories c
ON p.category_id = c.category_id
INNER JOIN sellers s
ON p.user_id = s.user_id
LEFT JOIN address a
ON s.address_id = a.address_id
WHERE p.product_id = #{productId}
